ev.q: an American crime drama television series created by Anthony Yerkovich
groundbreaking detective show that redefined the word
it generally prioritized music and stylized visuals over elaborate writing
Set to an electrifying soundtrack of rock legends
detractors objected to the show's usage of violence
Later the content was darker and cynical
relying more on visual aspects and music than on coherent stories and fully drawn characters
ran for five seasons on NBC from September 16, 1984, to June 28, 1989
